# DepartureBoard

> An open-source split-flap departure board for any TV. One `docker compose up` serves the board
> page and a settings page; a small JSON API does everything the settings page does, so your own
> script, automation or agent can put messages on the board and schedule them.

Base URL: the board's own host, e.g. `http://192.168.1.20:8080`. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
on every call except `GET /api/board/current` and `GET /images/{slug}`. The token is printed in the
server log on first boot and shown on `/settings`.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/messages/now` — show text now, above everything else. JSON `{"text": "…"}` or a `text/plain` body.
- `POST /api/messages` — create a message with a schedule: `starts_at`/`ends_at` (ISO-8601 with offset), or `repeat` `daily` with `repeat_start`/`repeat_end` (HH:MM, server timezone), or `repeat` `weekly` with `repeat_days` (Mon 1 … Sun 64, summed) and a time window. `priority` 0–100. `show_seconds` 5–600: how long this message holds the board when equals take turns (null = the display's `rotate_seconds`); `/now` takes it too.
- `GET /api/messages?state=live|scheduled|expired|disabled` — list. `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/messages/{id}`.
- `POST /api/messages/preview` — how a text lays out on the board; nothing stored.
- `GET/PATCH /api/settings` — `grid_preset` compact (6×22) | large (8×28) | custom (rows 4–10, cols 16–36), `animation` 0–100, `sound_enabled`, `sound_volume`, `theme` (classic-black, walnut, arctic-white, midnight), `idle_text`, `poll_seconds`, `rotate_seconds` (the default slot when equals take turns), `timer_ring` off | own | all (a countdown ring in the board's corner).
- `POST /api/images` (multipart `file`, optional `slug`), `GET /api/images`, `DELETE /api/images/{slug}` — pictures for `{img:slug}`; `PATCH /api/images/{slug}` `{w 1–36, h 1–10, fit contain|cover|stretch}` sets the block of cells the picture takes (the upload response's `suggested` lists the blocks that keep its shape); `{img:slug@WxH}` sizes it inline; `GET /images/{slug}` is public.
- `GET /api/board/current` — what the TV shows: `rows` of cells, `message_id`, `settings`, `stamp` as ETag (`If-None-Match` → 304). Public.
- `GET /api/health` — `{"ok": true, "version": "…"}`.

## Message text

Rows split on newlines, else word-wrap to the board's columns. Uppercased, accents stripped; characters outside A–Z 0–9 `! @ # $ ( ) - + & = ; : ' " % , . / ? °` show as a blank. Token cells, one cell each: `{red}` `{orange}` `{yellow}` `{green}` `{blue}` `{violet}` `{white}` `{black}`, any emoji. `{img:slug}` takes the picture's block (w × h cells, set with `PATCH /api/images/{slug}` or `@WxH`), placed as a word of its own and never cut; the rows beneath a tall block are pushed down. Capacity is rows × cols; a message that does not fit is a 422 with the reason.

## More

- `/docs` — the complete OpenAPI reference (Swagger), generated from the code.
- `/integrate` — every call above, pre-filled with this host and token (behind the settings token).
